tests.summary: Decide that a single moving figure occludes the static background across the 14-frame LS20 clip, rather than creating or destroying background regions.
tests.title: LS20 — moving figure occludes the background

tests.summary: An object becomes visible in the interior, not at a border.
tests.title: Appeared

tests.summary: An object crosses the left viewport boundary.
tests.title: Entered

tests.summary: A previously visible interior object cannot be found.
tests.title: Missing

tests.summary: A moving object leaves through the right boundary.
tests.title: Exited

tests.summary: The same observed object returns after a brief gap.
tests.title: Reappeared

tests.summary: One translation, with no intended shape or color change.
tests.title: Moved

tests.summary: Motion heading changes from rightward to downward.
tests.title: Turned

tests.summary: Rightward speed increases from two to four pixels per second.
tests.title: Accelerated

tests.summary: Rightward speed decreases from four to two pixels per second.
tests.title: Decelerated

tests.summary: An asymmetric L rotates 90 degrees clockwise in place.
tests.title: Rotated

tests.summary: A square grows uniformly about its center.
tests.title: Scaled

tests.summary: A square stretches horizontally and compresses vertically.
tests.title: Deformed

tests.summary: An equal-area L becomes a cross, not a rigid rotation.
tests.title: Shape changed

tests.summary: Only the object's color changes.
tests.title: Color changed

tests.summary: One centered boundary protrusion increases occupied area.
tests.title: Area changed

tests.summary: An interior empty region opens in a solid object.
tests.title: Hole opened

tests.summary: An object's enclosed hole is filled.
tests.title: Hole closed

tests.summary: A moving object contacts a wall then reverses direction.
tests.title: Bounce

tests.summary: Two approaching objects contact, then recoil.
tests.title: Collision

tests.summary: Two independent pieces form a coherent moving assembly.
tests.title: Group formed

tests.summary: An existing assembly separates into independent pieces.
tests.title: Group dissolved

tests.summary: A third piece joins an existing two-member assembly.
tests.title: Member added

tests.summary: One member leaves while a two-member assembly survives.
tests.title: Member removed

tests.summary: One connected body separates into two equal-area children.
tests.title: Split

tests.summary: Two separate bodies fuse into one connected result.
tests.title: Merged

tests.summary: Movement begins, continues, then stops.
tests.title: Move

tests.summary: Two bodies touch, remain touching, then separate.
tests.title: Contact

tests.summary: Two long edges join into an assembly, hold, then detach.
tests.title: Attached

tests.summary: Two outlined shapes geometrically overlap then separate.
tests.title: Overlap

tests.summary: Separated objects move together then their velocities diverge.
tests.title: Co move

tests.summary: Actor travels behind an opaque foreground strip and emerges.
tests.title: Occlude

tests.summary: Enclosure starts, persists, and ends.
tests.title: Contain

tests.summary: Enclosure starts, persists, and ends.
tests.title: Inside

tests.summary: A wall halts rightward movement; repeated attempts fail until the actor moves another way with the wall still standing.
tests.title: Blocked

tests.summary: Blocked with no observed inputs: the actor sits at the wall an extra frame, so a failed attempt must be abduced before movement resumes in another direction.
tests.title: Blocked (unobserved inputs)

tests.summary: Blue follows the red leader around a corner, then takes a different path.
tests.title: Follow

tests.summary: A platform picks up, transports, then leaves its load.
tests.title: Carry

tests.summary: Negative control: identical complete observations.
tests.title: No material change

tests.summary: Ambiguity control: identical-looking objects meet and identity is unresolved.
tests.title: Unknown

tests.summary: Approach, stand on plate, hold, step off; repeat independent cycles
tests.title: Plate momentary

tests.summary: Push a crate onto the plate, move the actor away, then remove the crate
tests.title: Plate crate hold

tests.summary: Intervene on each of two visible plates independently
tests.title: Plate unlinked control

tests.summary: Occupy plate to open door, then leave while door remains open
tests.title: Plate latched

tests.summary: Distinct rising-edge presses alternate door state; holding causes no repeated toggle
tests.title: Plate toggle

tests.summary: Occupy/release with a reproducible delay before response
tests.title: Plate delayed

tests.summary: Occupy A alone, B alone, both, neither, and release either
tests.title: Plate two inputs

tests.summary: Door opens on a timer in some trials while actor independently passes a plate
tests.title: Plate timer confound

tests.summary: Actor approaches, contacts a crate, then advances into it across multiple steps
tests.title: Push free

tests.summary: Repeat from left, right, above and below
tests.title: Push directions

tests.summary: Push crate against a wall; repeat attempt; remove obstacle and try again
tests.title: Push wall blocked

tests.summary: Try visibly similar but behaviorally different objects
tests.title: Push immovable

tests.summary: Push two touching crates with a free space beyond, then with a blocked far end
tests.title: Push chain

tests.summary: Push then move the actor away; crate stops in a non-inertial mechanism
tests.title: Push release

tests.summary: In a separate mechanism, crate continues after release and later slows
tests.title: Push inertial

tests.summary: Push crate onto a plate, leave it there, then push it off
tests.title: Push onto plate

tests.summary: Predict target color from the visible swatch order and observed click effects, including last-to-first wrap.
tests.title: Click-driven color cycle from a visible ordered band

tests.summary: Retain previously observed pixels while a circular sensor aperture moves across a fixed camera.
tests.title: Reconstruct a static scene through a moving spotlight

tests.summary: Retain an asymmetric actor's identity and motion hypothesis across exactly four completely hidden samples.
tests.title: Four fully hidden frames behind a slender pole

tests.summary: Separate observed approach/emergence from predicted hidden motion through a larger occluder's footprint.
tests.title: Four fully hidden frames behind a large opaque object

tests.summary: Learn a source/arrival association from witnessed remote reappearances, not from line colors or hidden portal wiring.
tests.title: Observed portal association versus ordinary occlusion

tests.summary: Traverse two/three-cell stair treads using RIGHT only; distinguish commanded horizontal motion, falling and final obstruction.
tests.title: Right-arrow stair descent with gravity and blocked-right evidence

tests.summary: Movement begins, continues, then stops. Includes a measured stationary warm-up interval.
tests.title: Move warmup v2

tests.summary: Separated objects move together then their velocities diverge. Includes a measured stationary warm-up interval.
tests.title: Co move warmup v2

tests.summary: Two approaching objects contact, then recoil. Classification waits for the supporting later observation.
tests.title: Collision confirmed v2

tests.summary: Two independent pieces form a coherent moving assembly. Classification waits for the supporting later observation.
tests.title: Group formed confirmed v2

tests.summary: An existing assembly separates into independent pieces. Includes independent observations before the membership change.
tests.title: Group dissolved history v2

tests.summary: A third piece joins an existing two-member assembly. Includes independent observations before the membership change.
tests.title: Member added history v2

tests.summary: One member leaves while a two-member assembly survives. Includes independent observations before the membership change.
tests.title: Member removed history v2

tests.summary: Blue follows the red leader around a corner, then takes a different path. Includes the history required before classification.
tests.title: Follow confirmed v2

tests.summary: A platform picks up, transports, then leaves its load. Includes the history required before classification.
tests.title: Carry confirmed v2

tests.summary: One visible frame sequence, two explicit input scripts; reconstruct only observed pixels.
tests.title: Fog of war: movement vs clicking

tests.summary: Derive a four-member assembly from verified source evidence, with stationary, weak-edge and missing-member controls.
tests.title: Group formation, joint motion and dissolution

tests.summary: Separate earlier controlled trials from a later bound action-response test; retain ambiguous and missing actors.
tests.title: Calibrate controls before binding the visible actor

tests.summary: A red bar sweeps across a green box, occluding it gradually then revealing it. Decide the box is hidden and shown again, not destroyed and recreated.
tests.title: Synthetic — gradual occlusion sweep

tests.summary: Accumulate a static scene through a spotlight moved by discrete arrow commands (ACTION1-4); the command stream is the only motion evidence.
tests.title: Spotlight scene by arrow commands
